labels.label: bdef:U_g

l.2343 'J the lightlike affine line of fixed points': for a linear parabolic g with R = id the fixed set c + ker(L(g) - id) has dimension n-2, not a line; J is read as the null direction nullPart U through a fixed point c, and J^perp as the union over decompositions L(g) = R U and fixed points of c + (nullPart U)^perp.
The last branch Ug = Omega_g covers exactly 'loxodromic, spacelike elliptic, non linear parabolic' given the trichotomy (classes_of_not, through LorentzTrichotomy).

Route: lifts of the vertical line delta through the local homeomorphism D over open intervals are unique on overlaps (M~ Hausdorff via the covering, D locally injective; mathlib IsSeparatedMap.eqOn_of_comp_eqOn); their union is a lift (private section MaxLift), which has no limit at a finite end of its domain (a local inverse of D near the limit continues it). A StrictlyExtends extension would give it such a limit: exists_end_of_upper/_lower (the time coordinate of D is a clock along the lift; the lower case by reflection). So the lift is causal (causalCurveIn_of_lift, extracted from lift_causalCurveIn) and inextensible, meets S~ (inextensible_comp + h.cauchy, no IsCausal needed), at the unique parameter where delta meets Sigma = graph g; h.injOn and uniqueness of lifts give injectivity. No Zorn, no concatenation lemma, no ODE were needed.

labels.label: remplacefini

hypotheses.note: the readings of Ug (W4, nonspacelike elliptic with fixed points, union reading of J^perp — now shown decomposition-independent)

findings: CLOSER PASS: Ug_zpow (first sentence, U(g^n) = U(g), n != 0) is proved sorry-free (#print axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), in the readings of Ug (SCOPE). UGamma_eq_of_index is now sorry-free too.

Omega_{g^n} = Omega_g holds for EVERY isometry with no class analysis (achronalDomain_zpow): if x and g^q x are causally related then x <= g^r x for r = +-q, hence x <= (g^r)^m x = (g^m)^r x by iteration.

The classes are stable under nonzero powers: L(g^n) elliptic/parabolic iff L(g) is (trichotomy + exclusivity; a Jordan block of L(g) gives one of L(g)^n); nonspacelike elliptic iff (g^n x - x = n(g x - x) along the unique L(g)-fixed displacement, fixedTrans_eq); linear parabolic iff (barycentre of a g^n-orbit, exists_smul_eq_self_of_pow).

J^perp does not depend on the parabolic decomposition (mem_nullHyperplanes_iff): every J is the line of the L(g)-fixed null vector v0, since a non-elliptic Lorentz map fixing a vector w and a null v0 has <w|v0> = 0 (else a fixed timelike combination). This settles the uniqueness question bdef:U_g left open; nullHyperplanes_zpow follows because fixed points of g^n differ from those of g by L(g^n)-fixed vectors.

Under W4, U(Gamma') = U(Gamma) for finite index is false with torsion: Gamma = {1, gamma}, gamma^2 = 1, Gamma' = 1 gives U(Gamma') = M^n, U(Gamma) = emptyset. Torsion-freeness holds under CCAction (CCAction.pow_ne_one).

kb_proposals: A statement whose type mentions no `d` (e.g. about `Deck (UniversalCover.proj M x₀)`) does not pick up section variable `{d}` nor `[ChartedSpace (Minkowski d) M]`: give it explicit `(d : ℕ)` binders outside the section; `hasGroupoid_flatCover M x₀` needs `(d := d)`.

Barbot §8's 'small convex neighbourhood B' arguments are best replaced by the domain of dependence: prove the inclusion on `dependenceDomain (minkowski d) ⊤ Σ`, then `graph_subset_interior_dependenceDomain` gives the interior.
`linOf g` elaborates to `AffineEquiv.linearHom ↑g`: multiplicativity is `show`, `Subgroup.coe_mul`/`coe_pow`/`coe_inv`, `map_mul`, `rfl`; use `linOf_mem g` (not `g.2`) for `lorentz` membership.

Mathlib has no continuity lemma for a strictly monotone map with interval image; `Flat.Develop.continuousOn_of_strictMonoOn` gives it, which is what lifting a `StrictlyExtends` reparametrisation through a covering needs.

Omega_{g^n} = Omega_g needs no classification: causally related iterates iterate (achronalDomain_zpow, Flat/Develop). Class stability under powers goes through a Jordan block (parabolic) or a null eigenvector (loxodromic) of L(g), plus Isometries' exclusivity lemmas.

A flat (Isom, M^n)-manifold in this library need not be Hausdorff: ChartedSpace + HasGroupoid carry no T2. Two copies of M^n glued along {t < 0} is causal, simply connected, has a Cauchy surface, and a non-injective developing map. Any statement that needs injectivity of developing maps or uniqueness of lifts must assume [T2Space M].

Maximal lifts through a LOCAL homeomorphism (not a covering) need no Zorn: take the union of all lifts over open intervals through the base point (unique on overlaps when the source is T2, mathlib IsSeparatedMap.eqOn_of_comp_eqOn + IsLocalHomeomorph.isLocallyInjective); the union is a lift and a local inverse at a finite-end limit continues it (Flat/Develop, private section MaxLift).

Inextensibility of a curve c with a continuous clock T (T (c s) = s): a StrictlyExtends extension with reparametrisation phi gives sup phi(J) = tau in I', and c'(tau) is a limit of c at sup J (finite because T is bounded near c'(tau)); the lower end by reflection s -> -s (Flat/Develop exists_end_of_upper/_lower).

The deck group of a covering of a Hausdorff, locally connected, connected E acts properly discontinuously: Flat/Develop finite_deck_of_isCompact (boxes U x V with at most one deck map sending U into V, compactness of K x K).
